Stop backing up "{0}"?

Yes: also delete its backups from the destination.
No: keep the backups there (you can add them back from Drives).

browse.footer: Double-click a folder to open it and a file to see a read-only copy of that version. Right-click to restore files or whole folders.
drives.title: Drives
drives.intro: Backups can go on any USB drive or external disk (NTFS, exFAT or FAT32), a folder on one, or a network share. Drives are recognised by identity, not by letter.
drives.empty: No external drives found. Plug in a USB drive or external disk, or choose a folder or network share when adding a set.
drives.import.question:
"{0}" was backed up from {1}.

Those folders exist on this PC. Keep backing them up from here?
Choose Cancel to only browse and restore its history.

settings.title: Settings
settings.startWithWindows: Start LocalBack when I sign in to Windows
settings.explorerMenu: Show "LocalBack versions" when right-clicking a file in Explorer
settings.battery: On battery, back up live changes at most every 15 minutes
settings.dailyCheckHint: Compares every file's size and date with the backup, to catch anything missed.
settings.retentionIntro: When a backup destination is almost full, old copies are thinned with this plan. The newest version of every file is always kept.
settings.autoFree: Do this automatically when space is low (otherwise ask first)
settings.pausedUntil: Paused until {0}. Changes are noted and backed up when it ends.
retention.keepLast.title: Keep only the last {0} versions of each file
retention.keepLast.desc: Older copies of the same file are removed. Good if you rarely go back more than a few saves.
retention.daily.title: Keep 1 version per day for 30 days, then 1 per week
retention.daily.desc: Thins out the many copies made on the same day. Keeps a long trail of changes.
retention.older.title: Remove versions older than {0} days
retention.older.desc: Everything from the last {0} days stays exactly as it is.
